script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. DINER - MORNING

WAITRESS (mid-30s, warm and welcoming) sets down a steaming cup of coffee in front of SAM (early 40s, disheveled and downtrodden). He gazes at it with a mix of gratitude and despair.

WAITRESS
(smiling)
Here ya go, Sam. Same as every morning.

SAM
(looking up)
Thanks, Martha.

Silence. Sam's eyes well up with tears. He takes a deep breath, then speaks.

SAM
I just can't take it anymore, Martha. The debt, the farm... I don't know what to do.

WAITRESS
(gently)
You're not alone, Sam. We'll figure something out.

EXT. SAM'S FARM - DAY

Sam stands at the edge of his barren field, staring at the lifeless earth. His worn overalls hang loose on his thin frame. He closes his eyes, takes a deep breath, and begins to speak.

SAM (V.O.)
I remember when this was a thriving farm. Cornfields as far as the eye could see. My father worked the land tirelessly, and my mother... she was the heart of the home. But now, it seems like everything I touch turns to dust.

INT. TOWN HALL - DAY

Sam sits in a packed town hall meeting. Farmers, townspeople, and local officials gather to discuss the drought that has ravaged their community. Sam's eyes meet with those of ANNE (late 20s, determined and passionate), a young activist. They exchange a knowing glance.

ANNE
We need to work together to find a solution. We can't let this community die.

SAM
(nodding)
I agree.

INT. LIBRARY - NIGHT

Sam and Anne pour over old agricultural records and research potential farming solutions. As they work, a sense of camaraderie and hope begins to fill the room.

SAM
This might just work, Anne. We could turn the tide on this drought.

ANNE
(smiling)
We'll make it work, Sam. Together, we can save our community.

EXT. FIELD - DAY

Sam and Anne work side by side, planting new crops and implementing innovative farming techniques. The townspeople join them, working together to revive the land.

EXT. TOWN SQUARE - DAY

A celebratory town gathering takes place in the town square. Sam and Anne stand before the crowd, their hard work evident in their worn clothing and sun-kissed faces.

ANNE
We did it, everyone. We've turned the tide on this drought. Our community is on the road to recovery.

SAM
(smiling)
But we couldn't have done it without all of you.

As the crowd cheers and embraces one another, Sam looks over to Anne, his heart filled with newfound hope and determination.

FADE OUT.
